ticks — ANNOTATE plot op

• Data kinds: image2d × axes → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.ticks(img, axes, xticks=None, yticks=None, color='neutral', width=1, tick_len=5, label=True, label_fmt='{:g}', font_size=11, font_path=None, scheme='okabe_ito', text_color=None, style=None) (to call the implementation directly, import annotate; annotate.ticks(img, axes, xticks=None, yticks=None, color='neutral', width=1, tick_len=5, label=True, label_fmt='{:g}', font_size=11, font_path=None, scheme='okabe_ito', text_color=None, style=None); from the registry, opsannotate.get("ticks"))

Usage

Tick marks and their values. The positions are closed form (:func:data_to_pixel itself).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

目盛りは枠の外側へ `tick_len` px 出す。ラベルは目盛りの外側に置くので、

軸の周りに余白が無ければ :func:text_box の境界検査が例外にする

(= 図の外に文字が消える事故が起きない)。

Raises

------

ValueError

tick_len が負、ラベルが画像に収まらない。
